primary.title: Ahead of ₹30,000-crore IPO, NSE's FY26 earnings serve up a reality check
primary.summary: A steep 16% drop in net profit and shrinking margins show how Sebi's derivatives crackdown and legacy legal settlements are taking a toll on the exchange's core business.
